title: "Indicator Seasons" classification (Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter) for MACD-Histogram
description: A four-way classification from Elder ch. 32, purely informational, low-risk to add: combine MACD-Histogram's slope (already computed for Impulse) with its position relative to the centerline (also trivial) into one of Spring (rising, below centerline -- best time to go long), Summer (rising, above -- crowd-recognized uptrend, take profits on longs into strength), Autumn (falling, above -- best time to go short), Winter (falling, below -- crowd-recognized downtrend, cover shorts into weakness). This is a pure informational label on top of an already-computed series -- does not touch _determine_signal or confidence scoring.

checklist.step: Implement the 4-way season classification as a small pure function on the existing macd_histogram series.
Unit tests covering all four season transitions.
Expose as a new field on GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/analysis (and indicator-history, for a historical season timeline); regenerate openapi.json/frontend types.
Document in docs/Analyse.md, explicitly noting this is informational only and not wired into signal logic.
